referenceSources.description:
Anthony Reid’s black MG ZS, sporting the number 6 and Dubai Autodrome branding, powers through a corner at Brands Hatch during the British Touring Car Championship on April 25, 2004. Sponsor decals for Mobil 1, Dunlop, Auto Express, Sparco, and others adorn the sleek bodywork, while a large rear wing and racing slicks emphasize its track-focused setup.

Captured with a 100 mm lens at 1/500 sec and f/7.1, the photograph highlights the car’s motion against the green grass and safety barriers lining the circuit. Exif data confirms ISO 200 and manual exposure settings, and the image is shared under a Creative Commons share-alike license requiring attribution.
